tools.name: list_apps
tools.description: Lists the apps this token can read: id, name, organization, platforms and the time of the last signal. Call this first to get an app_id.

tools.name: get_overview
tools.description: Users, sessions (a session ends after 30 minutes without a signal), signals, average session length and the top signal types of one app in a period. The same numbers as the portal overview.

tools.name: top_signals
tools.description: The most frequent signal types of one app in a period, with counts and first and last time seen.

tools.name: signal_breakdown
tools.description: Values of one property (or system field such as app_version, os_version, platform, country, device_model, locale) for one signal type of one app in a period, with counts.

tools.name: get_retention
tools.description: Weekly retention cohorts of one app: how many users (or sessions when the app sends no user) come back in the following weeks. Plans without retention answer with an error.

tools.name: get_funnel
tools.description: A funnel of 2 to 8 signal types in order: how many sessions (or users) reached each step within the window. Plans without funnels answer with an error.

tools.name: check_install
tools.description: Did any signal (or one signal type) arrive from this app in the last minutes, test and real ones? Answers the count, the last time, the SDK names and versions, and how many were test (debug) signals. Call it after installing the SDK.

tools.name: get_schema
tools.description: What this app sends: signal types of the last 30 days with their counts, the props keys of the 8 most frequent types, and the system fields you can break down or filter by.

tools.name: get_errors
tools.description: Errors and crashes of one app in a period: crash-free sessions, crashes, errors and affected users, the same per app version, and the 20 largest error groups. The same numbers as the portal Errors screen.
